name: io.github.vndee/llm-sandbox
title: LLM Sandbox
description: Securely run LLM-generated code in isolated containers across 7 languages and 4 backends.

runtimeArguments.name: --from
runtimeArguments.description: Install the MCP server extra. The base llm-sandbox package intentionally ships no container or MCP dependencies, so the extra is required for the server to start.

environmentVariables.name: BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: Container backend to use. Must match the installed extra: mcp-docker, mcp-podman, or mcp-k8s.

environmentVariables.name: DOCKER_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Docker or Podman socket URL, e.g. unix:///var/run/docker.sock

environmentVariables.name: KUBECONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to kubeconfig file when BACKEND=kubernetes.

environmentVariables.name: NAMESPACE
environmentVariables.description: Kubernetes namespace used for sandbox pods when BACKEND=kubernetes.

environmentVariables.name: COMMIT_CONTAINER
environmentVariables.description: Commit the container after a run so installed libraries persist between sessions.

environmentVariables.name: KEEP_TEMPLATE
environmentVariables.description: Keep the base image after the session ends to avoid re-pulling it on the next run.

environmentVariables.name: SANDBOX_NETWORK_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Network mode for the sandbox container. Set to 'none' for hardened isolation. Docker and Podman backends only.

environmentVariables.name: SANDBOX_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Mount the sandbox root filesystem read-only. Recommended: true. Docker and Podman backends only.

environmentVariables.name: SANDBOX_CAP_DROP
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated Linux capabilities to drop. Recommended: ALL. Docker and Podman backends only.

environmentVariables.name: SANDBOX_SECURITY_OPT
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated container security options, e.g. no-new-privileges. Docker and Podman backends only.

environmentVariables.name: SANDBOX_MEMORY
environmentVariables.description: Memory limit for the sandbox container, e.g. 4g. Docker and Podman backends only.

environmentVariables.name: SANDBOX_CPUS
environmentVariables.description: Fractional CPU allocation for the sandbox container, e.g. 1.5. Docker and Podman backends only.
